title: Lunenburg Ocean Adventures

services.name: Group Deep Sea Fishing!
services.desc: 4 Hours About Leave the scenic harbour of historic Lunenburg aboard the "Islander VIII” bound for the pristine waters of the North Atlantic for a fun half-day of fishing. We will sail by the lighthouse at the entrance to Lunenburg, and then by famous sea caves at Ovens Natural Park. Keep an eye out for dolphins, whales, and the occasional giant Ocean sunfish, or Bluefin Tuna! This is a group charter. PLEASE NOTE: 8 person minimum required to leave the dock. If the 8 person minimum is not met, we give the option to customers pay the difference Ages 4+ • 4 Hours • Up to 17 Spots
